claims.text: The Jasper architecture serves as a good baseline approach for exploring more sophisticated techniques in automatic speech recognition.
The training data for the models included the 2000hr Fisher+Switchboard dataset, which is a standard baseline in ASR research.
The study compares the performance of models trained using the same data, reporting results on the Hub5'00 benchmark, which is a common baseline in ASR.
